hypothesis.difference_from_r241: learns explicit positive family pairs and real OOS negative query-family pairs; it is not a threshold adjustment to the zero-shot score
hypothesis.optimizer: AdamW full-model fine tuning, one epoch, fixed seed

training.positive_source: R207 development pairs, mapped to current typed family documents
training.negative_source: deterministic R207 negatives plus public PRESTO/MASSIVE train rows with no BAXY family paired against every family document

development_evaluation.selection: SHA-256 ordered rows disjoint from the R236/R241 256+256 selections and from training OOS rows
development_evaluation.threshold: nextafter below minimum fresh inside maximum score; OOS excluded from selection
